records.eligibility_summary: Guaranteed incoming-freshman academic scholarship: ACT 34-36 and 3.5 GPA. Requires an application for admission as a new incoming freshman with the fee paid, official ACT (at least 22) and/or SAT (at least 1100) on file, a sixth-semester transcript showing the cumulative GPA, and proof of U.S. citizenship or permanent residence, by December 1, 2025.
records.renewal_requirements: Up to four years (eight semesters) while scholarship renewal eligibility requirements are met. The guide does not print the renewal GPA for this award; it says most scholarships require at least a 3.0 cumulative GPA and full-time enrollment.
records.notes: MTSU "True Benefits Scholarship Guide 2026-27". Only one guaranteed academic scholarship may be accepted; the student is offered the higher-dollar one. Students may be reconsidered for an award or upgrade with a higher December test score; that is an eligibility-data window, not negotiation. Read 2026-10-02 through a fetch tool that returns a model summary of the page rather than raw text; values have not yet been confirmed against the raw page, so the record stays partially_verified.
